items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He gave me five hundred dollars.

ctx.x: So I got this plan. So I go there and he said, 'Come on upstairs.' So we go up the elevator. A guy came down to get me. We go up the elevator and he's on the third floor. And he's got about six of his cronies there, and these chicks, half-naked chicks running all over the place. They had grabbed a whole wing of the hotel. And he said, 'Oh, thank you for coming. I'm so glad to see you, and I appreciate you being here.' He said, 'Have a seat. Won't you have a drink?' And the other cats with him, these country…

And he said, 'I'm going to show you why my heart is in the right place.' And he went in his pocket and he got a hundred dollar bill. He gave me five hundred dollars. He said, 'Now, thank you.' He said, 'Now, for your wife, since she's not, here, tell her I'm going to send her a ring...'
He was going to send me a watch, not a ring.
